title: 1828 Prairie, the Shipman house, rebuilt from its photographs
items: 1828 Prairie Avenue is no longer a plain draft block. It now stands as Daniel B. Shipman's light stone house: two tall storeys over a raised basement, under a slated mansard with dormers.
A canted bay rises through both storeys on the front, and a porch on columns with a deep entablature and a balustrade stands at the head of the stoop.
The porch's round arches, its carving and the carved pilasters on the bay are not built yet; they are next.
